scope: EHCO-PUB-SOW-010 public launch candidate, including C1/C1A executable proof and C1B comparative proof.

threats.control: C1 receipts are nonce-bound and launch verification checks the frozen proof/result identities; C1D independently requires a fresh public-only reproduction.
C1 and C1B manifests bind exact public files by SHA-256; the canonical launch validator recomputes those digests.
The C1B nine-file preregistration manifest is immutable for v1.0.0; the canonical launch validator requires every bound file to match its preregistered digest.
The public proof is offline/standard-library-only; C1B publishes its environment/reference acquisition contract and public result context while protected host details remain outside the public tree.
C1B binds OPA v1.20.2, source commit b2c26708e9d55645d7f837db495031f7e4152594 and asset SHA-256 69da5179ee403d10fa11bab6cfb4ffb0d23dba5f9b682fa977db772a1da5670f.
The preregistered protocol defines the shared fixture contract, asymmetry law, native-capability classification, one-run-per-case rule and published environment/reference conditions.
The public result manifest requires five planned and five recorded cases, empty omission and run-failure lists, published per-case outputs, and no preferred-result rerun.
The canonical public verifier validates preregistration and result hash closure plus launch-discovery and baseline cross-bindings; GitHub provider checks remain additional acceptance gates.
Public result and baseline limitations reject universal superiority, Runtime/authority/standing effects, deployment, proprietary same-code identity and independent certification.

limitations: This control model does not establish independent external reproduction.
It does not accept EHCOsystem Public Launch Baseline v1.
It does not replace owning technical evidence or create Tier One Runtime state, authority, admission, participation, deployment, release, or standing effects.
